entries.title: Psalms 10:1
segments: ¶Why do you keep far away, O Lord? why are you not to be seen in times of trouble?

entries.title: Psalms 10:2
segments: The evil-doer in his pride is cruel to the poor; let him be taken by the tricks of his invention.

entries.title: Psalms 10:3
segments: For the evil-doer is lifted up because of the purpose of his heart, and he whose mind is fixed on wealth is turned away from the Lord, saying evil against him.

entries.title: Psalms 10:4
segments: The evil-doer in his pride says, God will not make a search. All his thoughts are, There is no God.

entries.title: Psalms 10:5
segments: His ways are ever fixed; your decisions are higher than he may see: as for his haters, they are as nothing to him.

entries.title: Psalms 10:6
segments: He has said in his heart, I will not be moved: through all generations I will never be in trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 10:7
segments: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and false words: under his tongue are evil purposes and dark thoughts.

entries.title: Psalms 10:8
segments: He is waiting in the dark places of the towns: in the secret places he puts to death those who have done no wrong: his eyes are secretly turned against the poor.

entries.title: Psalms 10:9
segments: He keeps himself in a secret place like a lion in his hole, waiting to put his hands on the poor man, and pulling him into his net.

entries.title: Psalms 10:10
segments: The upright are crushed and made low, and the feeble are overcome by his strong ones.

entries.title: Psalms 10:11
segments: He says in his heart, God has no memory of me: his face is turned away; he will never see it.

entries.title: Psalms 10:12
segments: ¶Up! O Lord; let your hand be lifted: give thought to the poor.

entries.title: Psalms 10:13
segments: Why has the evil-doer a low opinion of God, saying in his heart, You will not make search for it?

entries.title: Psalms 10:14
segments: You have seen it; for your eyes are on sorrow and grief, to take it into your hand: the poor man puts his faith in you; you have been the helper of the child who has no father.

entries.title: Psalms 10:15
segments: Let the arm of the sinner and the evil-doer be broken; go on searching for his sin till there is no more.

entries.title: Psalms 10:16
segments: The Lord is King for ever and ever; the nations are gone from his land.

entries.title: Psalms 10:17
segments: Lord, you have given ear to the prayer of the poor: you will make strong their hearts, you will give them a hearing:

entries.title: Psalms 10:18
segments: To give decision for the child without a father and for the broken-hearted, so that the man of the earth may no longer be feared.
